title: The Lord Knows Us
verse: After these things the Lord’s message came to Abram in a vision: “Fear not, Abram! I am your shield and the one who will reward you in great abundance.
observation: At this point in the story of the life of Abraham, it may seem as though he has no more worries or fears. God has blessed him and all seems to be going well. However, the Lord truly knows us. Therefore, despite the look of blessing, the Lord knew Abraham needed to be reminded not to be afraid. We can hide our true feelings from others, and sometimes that is not a bad thing. However, the Lord truly knows us and will meet our true needs. Don’t ever be afraid to be honest with the Lord. He already knows.
application: Tell the Lord about it all.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for truly knowing us.
